page.overview:
What is Voice of All Things?

Voice of the Universe (Funimation subs, former)

The Voice of All Things refers to messages conveyed by non verbal means, whether it be from inanimate objects, animals, or the internal monologue of individuals. Seemingly only a very small number of individuals in the world possess the ability to hear this voice.

Hearing the Voice of All Things is a mysterious and incredibly rare ability that allows the user to communicate with people, creatures and objects in the world around them without the need for a physical message, such as speech or writing. It should not be mistaken for the ability to understand animal noises, as it is more akin to telepathy. The messages that come from these animals and objects appear to be completely inaudible to anyone who cannot hear the Voice. So far, only a minuscule number of people in the world have been shown to posses the ability to hear the Voice. Only one race in the world, the Three-Eye Tribe, possesses the innate ability to hear it; not only is this race extremely rare, but its members must also work to awaken the ability.

In most instances, whenever someone with the ability to hear the Voice comes in close proximity with an animal that can use the Voice, they will hear a constant, seemingly unintelligible noise, which can overwhelm them, especially if they are unfamiliar with the concept of the Voice and the ability to hear it. It also appears as though people can hear this voice to different degrees of proficiency. Whereas Roger, Oden, and Momonosuke constantly heard the Voice, or at least "felt" it around the Sea Kings and Zunesha, Luffy showed no indication of this; however, the Sea Kings still noted that Luffy had picked up their voices, and Luffy was later able to hear Zunesha when it called out for help.
